title: New Avengers: Doomsday art reveals details of Doctor Doom
seoTitle: New Avengers: Doomsday art reveals Doctor Doom details
subtitle: Image shows the villain alongside masked figures known as Latverian Witches.
excerpt: A newly released concept art for Avengers: Doomsday provides fresh details on Doctor Doom's look and the mysterious Latverian Witches.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The release of a new concept art for Avengers: Doomsday revealed details about the villain Doctor Doom and his followers known as the Latverian Witches. The image, shared by channels such as the @MCUFilmNews profile on X, highlights the character's connection to magical elements and his sovereign rule. The material raised new questions about the identity of the mysterious figures accompanying the villain in the production.

Doctor Doom's look and his followers

In the released image, Victor Von Doom stands at the bottom of a long staircase, wearing his classic metallic mask and signature dark cape. Above the steps, the Latverian Witches float as three mysterious figures clad in hooded cloaks and metallic facial masks identical to Doom's. Centered in the picture is the bold phrase: "DOOM HAS NO RIVALS". The concept art reinforces the focus on magic and the character's sovereign domination, presenting costumes that mimic Doctor Doom's visual style.

The costume reveal at San Diego Comic-Con 2026

Before the new art was unveiled, Marvel had already showcased the Latverian Witches' outfits at San Diego Comic-Con 2026. The garments were displayed on a single mannequin that cycled through three color variations: dark green, burnt orange, and violet. On the convention's final day, the setup was replaced by a towering statue of Doctor Doom, foreshadowing the importance of the follower group.

The mystery of the Latverian Witches' identities

Although Marvel keeps the members' identities under wraps, the similarity of the costumes to Doctor Doom's look sparked fan speculation. Theories suggest that known magic users in the Marvel Cinematic Universe—such as Wanda Maximoff, Clea, Sylvie, and Cynthia von Doom—could be part of the group. However, Marvel has only confirmed the group's existence and its direct link to the region of Latveria.

Exploring Latverian traditions in the film

The concept art released so far indicates that Avengers: Doomsday will adopt an approach centered on the villain's local customs. Rather than presenting a simple showdown, the film is expected to delve into Latverian traditions and the influence of mysticism on Victor Von Doom's rule. The silver armor and masks of the followers reinforce the unified aesthetic established by the Latverian leader.

With information from Yahoo.
